name: shadcn-calendar-heatmap
description: Reusable React calendar heatmap component package for displaying activity or time-series intensity in a shadcn/ui-style application.

metadata.github_description: Modern alternative to primitive react heatmaps.

SKILL.lean_review_note: Full tree contains one copyable calendar heatmap plus demo/documentation and stock shadcn primitives. Static scanning missed CalendarHeatmap because it is exported at the end of its source. Retain that component and the reusable copy-control variants. Merge the LLM copy-label variant into the general clipboard control; framework layout, header/footer, icon registry, example-code showcase and private demo package do not add independent capability boundaries.
